title: Day 1 — Code Comprehension & Debugging
prompt: Staging fell over last night: our gateway couldn't read '[server] port' as an int and socket.bind crashed. This little config loader is what parses it, and its test suite is failing. Where do you start?

clarifications.answer: Values are coerced: true/false -> bool, integers -> int, decimals -> float, everything else stays str. A version like 1.0.0 must stay a string.
Full-line comments and blank lines are skipped; an inline comment after a value (' # ...') is stripped from the value.
Keys and values are trimmed of surrounding whitespace.
A repeated key keeps the LAST value; a repeated [section] merges into the existing one.
Keys before any [section] header go under a section named DEFAULT.
Only the first '=' separates key from value, so values may contain '='.

hints: Read each function first and write a one-line summary; triage the failures by symptom class (type, whitespace, comment, dedup, split).
Look hard at _coerce (bool('false') is True!) and at how lines are split and stripped.
Fix surgically: strip lines/keys/values, strip inline comments, coerce in the right order, split('=', 1), merge sections, and let the last duplicate key win.
